snippet.title: Ourobolos Gameplay
snippet.description:
Game link : https://brakacee.itch.io/ourobolos
Ourobolos is a game where you control the infamous Ourobolos, a creature terrifying the city. 

To grow and survives, he needs to loop around citizens.
